💡 لماذا يرتبط سعر الذهب بالريال السعودي: 💡 Why the price of gold in Saudi riyals follows the dollar exactly
الريال السعودي مربوط بالدولار الأمريكي ب: The Saudi riyal has been pegged to the US dollar at a fixed rate since 1986: SAR 3.75 per dollar — one of the longest-lasting currency pegs in the world, unchanged for more than forty years. This means any change in the gold price here exactly reflects the global change in dollars, with no additional effect from local exchange-rate fluctuations.
عيار 24 هو الذهب الخالص، بينما الأعيرة ا: 24 karat is pure gold, while the lower karats (22, 21, 18) are alloyed with other metals for hardness and to withstand daily wear. When buying, compare the making charge between several shops (it varies a lot and sometimes affects the final price more than the gold price itself), always ask for an invoice stating the karat and the weight of the piece, and if your goal is investment, 24-karat bars and coins are better than jewelry because you do not lose the making charge when reselling.
